''1ˢᵗ'' - Belownatural |difficulty = Easy |length_measurement = 00:42.83 |wave_structure = Normal |rewards = {{RewardsList|Easy|Hardcore = Hide|Voidcore = Hide}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Toyboard''', as the name suggests, takes place on a toyboard which is located in a massive bedroom. '''Toyboard''' has the [[Enemies Beta]] modifier, which changes the appearance of some enemies, replaces some enemies with other enemies and changes stats of some enemies. ==Design & Path== {{Tabber |Current & Version 4 |The current version of '''Toyboard''' is a light-patterned board with wooden borders. The board is placed in the middle of a child's bedroom. The bedroom has a brown wooden floor, green walls and a white ceiling. On the walls there was a window, brown wooden door and a light switch. There was also a green carpet in the middle of the room. There are multiple toys scattered across the board and carpet. Most of them are colorful plastic and wooden building bricks, and jigsaw puzzle pieces. A toy fire truck, toy ambulance, toy police car, teddy bear, two cans of cola, one spilled, and Roblox mystery figure boxes all can also be found here. A massive brick castle stands prominently at one edge of the board, complete with a blue flag. There is also furniture in the room. To the left of the window, there is a brown wooden bed with a green pillow and blanket. There is also a brown wooden drawer next to the bed. Under the window, there is a white radiator. To the right of the window, there are three boxes placed underneath a table. To the left of the door, there are two boxes, one blue and the other red. To the right of the door, there is a brown wooden bookshelf. There is also a green box between the bookshelf and bed. The building brick path starts at the Roblox mystery figure boxes and ends at the toy castle. It takes arbitrary corners, which means it cuts back on itself several times. The fourth version of '''Toyboard''' is the same as the current one except it used pre-2022 Roblox textures instead of the custom textures. |Version 3 |The third version of '''Toyboard''' was a light-patterned board with wooden borders. The board was placed in the middle of a child's bedroom. The bedroom had brown wooden floor, green walls and a white ceiling. On the walls there was a window, brown wooden door and a light switch. There was also a green carpet in the middle of the room. There were multiple toys scattered across the board and carpet. Most of them were colorful plastic and wooden building bricks, and jigsaw puzzle pieces. A toy fire truck, teddy bear, two cans of cola, one spilled, and Roblox mystery figure boxes, which act as the entrance for enemies. A massive brick castle stood prominently at one edge of the board, complete with a blue flag. There was also furniture in the room. To the left of the window, there was a brown wooden bed with a white pillow and green blanket. There was also a brown wooden drawer next to the bed. To the right of the window, there were three boxes full of toys, mostly building bricks and plushies. To the left of the door, there were two boxes, one blue and the other red. To the right of the door, there was a brown wooden bookshelf. There was also a green box between the bookshelf and bed. The building brick path started at the Roblox mystery figure boxes and ended at the toy castle. It took arbitrary corners, which meant it cut back on itself several times. |Version 2 |The second version of '''Toyboard''' was a massive light-patterned board with wooden borders. There were various toys around the [[Maps|map]], including a teddy bear, letter blocks, building bricks, toy fire engine and a jigsaw puzzle piece. Additionally, there were some playing cards, a spilt can of Bloxy Cola and a biro pen. A massive brick castle stands prominently at one edge of the map, complete with a blue flag. The puzzle stud path begins at the small cardboard box and ends at the toy castle. It takes arbitrary corners, which means it cuts back on itself several times. |Version 1 |The first version of '''Toyboard''' was a massive light-patterned board with wooden borders. There were various toys around the [[Maps|map]], including a teddy bear, letter blocks, building bricks, toy fire engine and a jigsaw puzzle piece. Additionally, there were some playing cards, a spilt can of Bloxy Cola and a biro pen. A massive brick castle stands prominently at one edge of the map, complete with a blue flag. In one corner of the map, there were two wooden bricks, one blue with a large T on it and the other red with a large B on it. The puzzle stud path begins at the small cardboard box and ends at the toy castle. It takes arbitrary corners, which means it cuts back on itself several times. }} ==Interactive Map== {{Tabber |Current |{{Map:ToyboardV4}} |Version 4 |{{Map:ToyboardV3}} |Version 3 |{{Map:ToyboardV2}} |Version 2 |{{Map:Toyboard}} }} ==Rewards== The game calculates how many {{Coins|Coins}}, {{Gem|Gems}} and {{Exp|}} you receive based on how many waves you survived and if you won a match. During periods of 50% more {{Exp|}} (Friday – Sunday), any {{Exp|}} earned is multiplied by 1.5x through the [[XP Boost]] modifier. The VIP [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] also multiplies any {{Exp|}} earned by 1.25x through the [[VIP Boost]] modifier. These two boosts are additive. Regular {{Exp|}} boosts are multiplicative with other modifiers present on this map. Any rewards that end in a decimal point is rounded down, no matter the first figure of the leading decimal. {{Rewards|Easy|Hardcore = Hide|Voidcore = Hide}} ==Strategy== *The middle of the map is the best place to place ground towers due to the abundance of corners. *Cliff towers should be placed on the playing cards in the middle of the map, as from this spot they can cover most of the map without [[Range Buff]]s. *This map is quite ideal for the [[Ace Pilot]] and [[Pursuit]] as their flying pattern closely lines up with the path and can easily cover all if not most of the path. *This map has a lot of turns, making the corners useful for towers with short range, such as the [[Brawler]], [[Warden]], [[Shotgunner]] and [[Pyromancer]]. *This map has a lot of straight lines making piercing towers like [[Frost Blaster]] and [[Archer]] more useful. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Map Icons}} ToyBoard.png|First version (18 June 2019 – 31 March 2023) ToyboardIconV2.png|Second version (31 March 2023 – 28 January 2026) {{GalleryHeader|View}} Toy.png|Second version (18 June 2019 – 31 March 2023) ToyboardViewV2.png|Third version (31 March 2023 – 28 January 2026) Toyboard2026View.png|Fourth version (28 January 2026 – 11 February 2026) {{GalleryHeader|Top Down}} ToyboardTopDown.png|Second version (18 June 2019 – 31 March 2023) ToyboardTopDownV2.png|Third version (31 March 2023 – 28 January 2026) Toyboard2026TopDown.png|Fourth version (28 January 2026 – 11 February 2026) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} AprUpdate2023.png|Third version on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Tower Defense Simulator Roblox Trailer|Third version on a promotional video. ToyboardDI6.png|Current version on a development image. {{GalleryHeader|Renders}} ToyboardThumbnailClean.png|Third version on a render. }} ==Trivia== *The current icon for '''Toyboard''' shows an early version of it, as the map there is set at night. In-game, it is a daytime map instead. *An Easter egg was once found with BelowNatural's X (known as Twitter at the time) handle on the back of the castle. **On the first version of the castle, there used to be a picture of BelowNatural. The Twitter handle was also outdated on that version of the map. *The second icon of '''Toyboard''' shows an unused version of it. **Most notably, the playing cards are still on the side of the map, while in-game they are placed in the middle of the map. **On the icon, there is a cliff spot to the right of the entrance, which was also present on the first version of the map. This cliff spot is not present in-game. **In-game, there are two cliff spots near the exit, one large to the left of it and one smaller to the right of it. On the icon only the larger cliff spot is present. **The cola cans are much closer to the path than they are in-game. In-game, they are on the corner of the board, while on the icon they are behind one of the cliff spots. *'''Toyboard's''' third version had two unusual cliff spots near the edges of the map. **The first is a few blocks placed on the edge of the map, near the plush bear. These cliff spots are one of the lowest in the entire game, being very close to the ground. **The second is an invisible brick near the soda cans, which counts as a cliff spot. This means cliff towers can be placed on nothing and float midair. **As both of these spots are placed at the edges of the map, most cliff towers were unable to reach the path from them. *This first version of '''Toyboard''' was originally a map submission for ''Tower Battles'', a different Roblox game, before becoming a map in Tower Defense Simulator. *Weirdly, on one of the game thumbnails, the walls in '''Toyboard''' are blue, but in-game they are actually green. ==Update History== {{scroll|text = *'''18 June 2019''' - [[BETA v1.1|BETA v1.1.1]] **'''Toyboard''' added. **{{Bug}} Arrows appear at the corner of the map. *'''19 June 2019''' - [[BETA v1.1|BETA v1.1.1a]] **Removed wooden bricks from the corner of the map. **{{Bugfix}} Arrows now properly appear on the path instead of in a corner. *'''2 August 2019''' - [[BETA v1.7|BETA v1.7.0]] **Difficulty changed from {{Color|OldNormal}} to {{Color|OldEasy}}. *'''5 August 2019''' - [[BETA v1.8|BETA v1.8.0]] **{{Color|OldEasy}} difficulty removed. *'''29 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul v1.0.0]] **{{Color|Easy}} difficulty added. **No longer gives a badge upon first triumph. **{{Bug}} '''Toyboard''' is very bright. *'''12 March 2022''' - [[v1.1.0]] **{{Bugfix}} '''Toyboard''' is no longer very bright. *'''4 July 2022''' - [[v1.2.5]] **'''Toyboard''' is now slightly brighter. *'''31 March 2023''' - [[v1.6.4]] **'''Toyboard''' remade. **[[Enemies Beta]] modifier added. **{{Bug}} There is a floating invisible brick near the soda cans. *'''28 January 2026''' - [[v1.84.0]] **'''Toyboard''' remade. **{{Bugfix}} The floating invisible brick near the soda cans has been removed. *'''11 February 2026''' - [[v1.85.0]] **Updated textures to use the intended ones. *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **[[Enemies Beta]] removed. }} {{MapNavBox}}
